column1: # NUR067 — await's winner-takes-all modes (first / any) hand back the
# winning branch's WHOLE residual: 0-or-more values, a count that can
# EXCEED any static seat. A single branch makes the nondeterministic
# modes deterministic, so these rows are green semantics.
# GRADUATED 2026-09-10 (the runtime-variadic REGION representation): the
# compile pass no longer refuses these modes wholesale. awaitVariadicResult
# now returns the SAME variadic-spread carrier on both passes, the recorder
# turns that one out into a region event (callVariadicRegion →
# eventFlags.variadicRegion), and the lowerer gives it a value-producing
# LOOP's representation — one simulated slot marked lw.variadic. The
# plain-residual row therefore compiles and has moved to
# lang/spec/module-time.tsv.
# The INERT-PREFIX row (`99 await {mode:'first'} [[]]`) graduated in the
# same batch with its loop twin `99 for 3 [i]`, on the shared
# OpSeatBelowMark lowering — both in lang/spec/bytecode-migrated.tsv.
# What is left is the one row whose CONSUMER needs a static count: a
# collecting paren has to build a List of the run, and no op does that yet.
# It is not an await frontier — it refuses for exactly the reason its loop
# twin `size [(for 3 [i])]` refuses — so its graduation is the general one
# and graduates the `for` spelling in the same stroke.
import "boru:time-util" size [(TimeUtil.await {mode:'any'} [[7 8]])]
